profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead at The Walt Disney Company
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer, web/mobile application developer, and developer evangelist who has been building bleeding edge applications for over 20 years. Whether for a local business or a multi-national corporation, I strive to build applications that people feel they cannot live without.

In 2006 I started Mindelusions, Inc, a web development and brand management company located in Henderson, Nevada. We specialize in the design and development of customized user-centric web and mobile applications, the implementation and customization of already existing solutions, and the creation of personal and corporate branding and online presence. From concept to reality we create scalable solutions that focus primarily on compatibility, accessibility, and are, of course, standards based.

I am a StartupBus alum, an entrepreneur, and I love developing and evangelizing new technologies. 

Specialties: - Developer Evangelism/Relations, Solutions Architecture, Appcelerator Titanium Development, Mobile Application Development, Web Application Development, Startups, Social Media

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.description:
Be part of a strong development team implementing and maintaining web applications across WDPRO websites
Develop high quality code adhering to engineering best practices including automated unit and integration testing, code reviews, and documentation
Understanding WDPRO architectural vision and how it helps meet WDPRO business objectives
Analyzing user stories and participating in sprint planning, scrums, demos and retrospectives
Accountable for uptime and high-availability for all solutions
Accountable for performance and usability in all solutions
Coordinating with Architecture group on new designs and foundational / infrastructural application changes
Be a subject matter expert in both technology and the specific domain of the team
Balance technical requirements and best practices with business requirements and deadlines
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including:
project plan task estimates
use case and object modeling
detailed design documents
framework design and development
code development
performance testing and tuning
maintenance of production issues
Integrating mobile application code with back-end services
Integrating web code using primarily Angular and Node with back end services
Understanding the need for optimized responses based on the device being used
Negotiating and adjusting requirements by collaborating with internal business partners
Learning new technologies when required.
Performing peer code reviews for immediate and related teams
Understanding of continuous integration / continuous delivery concepts and the ability to troubleshoot related issues.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Responsibilities include owning technical engagements and driving the ultimate success of partner projects. Being the “face of Amazon” with key partners while driving discussions with senior technical leaders in those organizations. Constantly thinking strategically about business, product, and technical challenges while mapping the intersection of partner needs and Amazon priorities. Possess excellent customer engagement and communication skills as well as the technical background to fluently interact and provide guidance to software developers and architects.
Key Responsibilities:
· Provide technical support to strategic developers
· Actively identify opportunities to deliver experiences that demonstrate what is possible on Amazon devices and services
· Develop unique, compelling and exciting presentations and demonstrations of new Amazon technologies
· Delivering persuasive, passionate, high impact, high quality presentations to senior decision makers
· Educate developers on Amazon devices and service offerings
· Document best practices and create development resources that can be used by other developers.
· Build reference architecture, frameworks and toolkits to drive scale of adoption in the ecosystem.
· Manages complex projects with significant bottom-line impact.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Thumbtrotter is an innovative web and mobile application that enables users to find, organize, and implement carpooling efforts to their desired destination.

positions.title: Platform Evangelist
positions.description: Appcelerator is the leading mobile development platform company for enabling the rapid development of native mobile, desktop, and tablet applications using Web technologies. We have big plans for growth and are aggressively hiring for our HQ office. Appcelerator’s flagship product, Titanium, is a free and open source application development platform that lets you create native mobile, tablet and desktop application experiences using Web Development skills. Developers can use their existing web skills in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, Ruby, and PHP.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Created on the 2012 Las Vegas Startup Bus. OpenWallet is a mobile application with the ability to turn everyone around you into a human ATM. I built this application in 3 days using the Titanium platform.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Since 1999 Broadcasting Concepts, Inc. has been breaking barriers streaming the highest quality of video, chat, and audio on the net today. With the worlds' technological growth, Broadcasting Concepts has formulated solutions for business and the public to better communicate through the use of video, chat, and audio over the Internet. Our staff is committed to solving new ways to better our process and tend to the needs of customers and clientele.

positions.title: Cryptoloqic Linguist
positions.description: Cryptologic linguists monitor, transcribe, and translate intercepted target communications; perform analysis and exploitation of designated foreign communications; and install, operate, and perform preventive maintenance of intercept equipment. Following basic qualification as a linguist (2776-2794), Marines attend a specialized course of instruction and upon completion are assigned the appropriate MOS. Secondary duties and tasks include aspects of EW/COMSEC and direction-finding operations. In addition, Marines assigned MOS 2676 receive MOJT in such MOS-related requirements as power supply operation, equipment prime mover (truck) operation, and vehicle maintenance procedures. Intermediate and advanced language training is available.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Using knowledge of electrical theory and concepts, Electricians install, operate, maintain, and repair underground, above ground, and overhead electrical power distribution systems. Additionally, electricians operate and perform organizational level maintenance on electrical power generation equipment, load banks, and floodlight sets. When on Military Operations Other Than War (MOOTW) they install and repair interior wiring in buildings. These duties include installing hardware, including cross-arms, insulators, and lightning arresters, and assembling/erecting and climbing utility poles/towers; stringing wire conductors; measuring, cutting, bending, assembling, and installing electric conduit; installing control and distribution apparatus, such as switches, relays, and circuit breakers; testing circuits for continuity, compatibility, and safety, including ground, of components, using test instruments such as multi-meters and ohmmeters; and installing and repairing electric fixtures. Noncommissioned officers are afforded the opportunity to attend the Advanced Electrician Course that provides in-depth instruction on the requirements of the National Electric Code and the planning of electrical support to include determining demand, phase balancing, and voltage drops. An apprenticeship program, leading to U.S. Department of Labor certification as a Journey Worker, is available to electricians under the United Services Military Apprenticeship Program (USMAP).
